messages:
maria: Quick sync: token-cost attribution pipeline status — blockers? target: schema + canary by EOD Fri. PR #4321 opened. pinging owners.

 dinesh: I'll own event schema. Posting draft in PR comments. Question: do we keep token_type field or dedupe to token_group?

 kevin: Latency breakdown queries: I need sample SLO spans from runtime traces. @olivia can you export a 7-day sample?

 olivia: On it, will dump to /tmp/rt-traces-7d.jsonl and share link in PR.

 sam: Quick heads-up: ingestion change in eng-infra (kafka partitioning) lands Wed — that may affect canary. @maria do we want to delay?

 maria: Prefer not to delay. Plan: canary on current infra first, then re-run post-change. Need feature-flag gating. @jessica can you add FF?

 jessica: Yes, adding flag rf_token_attrib_canary. ETA today noon. Also will add rollout plan doc.

 kevin: For reviewers: please check query in PR — it's using windowed aggregates. Example:
```sql
SELECT model, sum(tokens) as toks, sum(cost) as cost
FROM token_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY model
```

 dinesh: Schema draft (snippet):
```json
{"event_type":"token_usage","model":"gpt-4o","tokens":123,"cost_cents":45}
```

 olivia: Dump uploaded: https://internal-s3.redwood/rt-traces-7d.jsonl (read-only). Contains span_id, latency_ms, route.

 sam: FWIW infra change adds header X-partition-key; we can map session_id to partition key in canary config.

 maria: Next steps: dinesh finalize schema + unit tests; kevin run query & add dashboards; jessica add FF + rollout; olivia upload trace sample to PR; sam confirm infra gating. Deadline: Fri EOD. :thumbsup:

 kevin: :raised_hands: Can do dashboards today. tagging @oncall for any trace gaps.

 qa-bot: CI: PR #4321 — tests passing (8/8). Integration test failing on merge stage, investigating...

 dinesh: Noted failing integration test, looks like env var TOKEN_ATTRIB_BUCKET missing in CI. Pushing fix.

 qa-bot: CI: PR #4321 — merge pipeline passed after env fix. :white_check_mark:

 maria: Thanks all. If anything blocks, drop a short note here. I'll update project board.
